text: Przepraszam for the late hour, I am grandad, looking after my granddaughter Zosia, she is 3. Temperature is 38.6, I checked twice. She was sick one time this evening, but after that she drink her water and juice and it all stayed down, nothing came back. Also she has not done a poo for three days now and she is very grumpy, marudzi about it all the time. I am scared, her mama is away and I don't know what is normal. I checked her neck like they say on TV, she can look down to her tummy and her toes, no problem, ok. And no shaking, no jerking, nothing like a fit, I watch her the whole time. Boże, I just want to know if I do the right thing. Dziękuję.
